title: DPC 0.9.178-dev4: leaning / sitting pawns, onsen, Galvanize, Ferrystone crash, Ctrl+F6 on a controller
intro: About 30-40 min, done in any order you can manage; End skips a step you can't do (just tell Claude). You need: a tavern with a leaning pawn, benches/chairs, the onsen (hot spring), a Sorcerer and a Mage pawn with Galvanize, a Ferrystone plus a Portcrystal, two controllers. SAVE in a spare slot before steps 6, 12 and 13. Keep Task Manager handy for freezes. Settings are the fresh defaults.

probes.ver: local A=_G.DPC_API; return A and A.dpc_version or 'no API'
probes.played: local A=_G.DPC_API; local s=A and A.state(); return s and s.played and (s.played.name or '?') or '-'
probes.ferry: local R=_G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R; local f=R and R.ferry; return f and ('hooks '..tostring(f.hooks)..' live '..tostring(f.live)..' n '..tostring(f.n)) or '-'
probes.galv: local R=_G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R; return R and R.galv_last and tostring(R.galv_last):sub(1,160) or '-'
probes.stale_dash: local R=_G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R; return R and R.stale_dash_n or 0
probes.coop: local A=_G.DPC_API; local s=A and A.state(); if not (s and s.coop.active) then return 'off' end; local n=0; for _ in pairs(s.coop.players) do n=n+1 end; return n..' players'

steps.text: Start. Top line: ver should read 0.9.178-dev4 and ferry 'hooks 10'. Press End.
1/17 TAVERN LEAN, single player: wait for a pawn to lean on a wall, take it over. It should stand, then be yours, no freeze. Let go and repeat twice. End.

2/17 TAVERN LEAN, co-op: while a pawn leans, Ctrl+F6 and press a button on controller 2. Then player 2 switches onto a leaning pawn. Co-op waits for the stand-up, no freeze. Player 2 leaves (L3+R3 3 s). End.
3/17 Take over a pawn the moment it walks toward a wall or bench. No freeze; the DPC log may show up to 3 lines '... is in an object interaction: asked it to stop'. End.
4/17 BENCH / CHAIR: take over a pawn sitting down. It stands, then yours. Note whether 'waiting for <name> to stand' showed. End.
5/17 ONSEN PROBE: get the whole party bathing in the hot spring. Do NOT take anything over yet. When everyone is in the water, press End (it reads the onsen state, nothing else).
Reading the onsen state...
steps.each_frame:
if _G.__spa1_done then return end
_G.__spa1_done=true
local function run()
-- Onsen (hot spring) report, Nexus 2026-11-26 (grovermclurg): "Freezes game if used while sitting in onsen".
-- Run it while the Arisen and the party are IN the onsen, before taking anything over. Read-only.
-- Question: is bathing an InteractManager object interaction (what R.busy_interact sees, like the tavern lean), or
-- only the onsen's own system (app.SpaManager and its SpaState* states, which the decompile shows controlling the
-- player's and party's positions: SpaRequestContainer.setupCharacterControlListPlayer, SpaStateCharacterPosControl)?
-- If getActiveInteract is nil for everyone while bathing, DPC's lean guards don't see the onsen and a take-over
-- needs its own check (e.g. refuse or wait while SpaManager is active).
local out = {}
local function add(s) out[#out + 1] = tostring(s) end
local function tn(o) local ok, n = pcall(function() return o:get_type_definition():get_full_name() end); return ok and n or "?" end
local function fields(o, max)
  local l = {}
  local ok = pcall(function()
    local td = o:get_type_definition()
    while td and #l < (max or 60) do
      for _, f in ipairs(td:get_fields()) do
        if not f:is_static() then
          local okv, v = pcall(f.get_data, f, o)
          local s = okv and (type(v) == "userdata" and ("<" .. tn(v) .. ">") or tostring(v)) or "?"
          l[#l + 1] = f:get_name() .. "=" .. s
        end
      end
      td = td:get_parent_type()
      if td and td:get_full_name():find("^System%.") then break end
    end
  end)
  if not ok then l[#l + 1] = "(fields failed)" end
  return table.concat(l, ", ")
end
local spa = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.SpaManager")
add("SpaManager: " .. (spa and tn(spa) or "nil"))
if spa then add("  " .. fields(spa, 80)) end
local im = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.InteractManager")
local function who(ch, label)
  if not ch then add(label .. ": nil"); return end
  local ai = im and select(2, pcall(im.call, im, "getActiveInteract(app.Character)", ch))
  local fsm = ch:call("get_ActionManager"):get_field("Fsm")
  local n0 = fsm and tostring(fsm:call("getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)", 0)) or "?"
  local n1 = fsm and tostring(fsm:call("getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)", 1)) or "?"
  local cmd = "?"
  pcall(function()
    local ex = ch:call("get_AIDecisionMaker"):call("get_DecisionModule"):call("get_ActionInterface"):call("get_Executor")
    local p = ex:get_field("_CommandExecutor"):get_field("_PrimaryCommand")
    cmd = p and tn(p) or "none"
  end)
  local dec = "?"
  pcall(function()
    local d = ch:call("get_AIDecisionMaker"):call("get_DecisionModule"):call("get_DecisionExecutor"):call("get_ExecutingDecision")
    dec = d and tostring(d:call("get_PackPath") or tn(d)) or "none"
  end)
  add(string.format("%s: activeInteract=%s nodes=%s | %s cmd=%s decision=%s", label, ai and tn(ai) or "nil", n0, n1, cmd, dec))
  if ai and type(ai) == "userdata" then add("  interact: " .. fields(ai, 30)) end
end
who(sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CharacterManager"):call("get_ManualPlayer"), "Arisen")
local list = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.PawnManager"):call("get_PawnCharacterList")
for i = 0, (list and list:call("get_Count") or 0) - 1 do who(list:call("get_Item", i), "pawn " .. i) end
return table.concat(out, "\n")

end
local ok,r=pcall(run)
pcall(json.dump_file,'test_guide/spa1_onsen_out.json',{ok=ok,out=tostring(r),t=os.time()})

steps.text: 6/17 ONSEN TAKE-OVER: SAVE FIRST. While everyone bathes, take over a pawn. Freeze or not? If it froze, stop testing and tell Claude. End.
7/17 ONSEN RELEASE: let go back to the Arisen while still in the water, then walk out. No freeze? End.
8/17 (only if it comes up, else End) QUICK-SKILL STANCE while leaning: Numpad launch stance on a pawn, let it lean, same key again. No freeze. End.

9/17 GALVANIZE, played Sorcerer: out of combat, take over the Sorcerer, use some stamina, hold Galvanize about 2 s. The 'galv' line at the top should update (job 6) and stamina should rise during the hold. End.
10/17 GALVANIZE, played Mage (job 3): same. Then let go and hold Galvanize on the Arisen if he is a Mage or Sorcerer. End.
11/17 SPRINT: on a played pawn, sprint, then stop with the stick at rest. If 'stale_dash' goes up, did stamina then come back? Sprinting should feel as before. End.

12/17 FERRYSTONE while playing a pawn: SAVE FIRST. Take over a pawn, use a Ferrystone, pick a Portcrystal. Expect: back on the Arisen at once, no camera glide or slow motion, teleport plays, NO crash. End after landing.
13/17 FERRYSTONE right after switching back: SAVE FIRST. Take over a pawn, switch back to the Arisen (the transition plays), and within 1-2 s use a Ferrystone. No crash? End after landing.
14/17 Use a Ferrystone again; DURING the teleport press the take-over key. Expect only the note 'Not during a Ferrystone'. About 2 s after landing, take-over works again. End.
15/17 CO-OP FERRYSTONE: Ctrl+F6 + controller 2, then use a Ferrystone. Co-op ends like on a cutscene, no crash. End.
16/17 Open the Ferrystone map and back out without travelling. Did DPC let go of the pawn anyway? (harmless either way) End.

17/17 CTRL+F6 ON A CONTROLLER: play the Arisen on controller 1, press Ctrl+F6, then press a button on controller 2. Expect the note 'player 1 keeps their controller'; player 2 has the pawn; P1 attacks and skills work on the Arisen; P2 can't move the Arisen. End co-op, repeat with both controllers on from the start, then once from keyboard/mouse (P1 stays on keyboard). End.
Done. Tell Claude pass/fail for each step (and anything odd). Press End.
